answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in delta and jade lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the plume graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 510 impostors cost 1743 times the honest price and take 6 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
